CheckTitle: Password lockout duration is finite and not indefinite
Description: Checks active password policies configure finite auto-unlock.
Risk: Indefinite lockouts increase operational risk and can amplify denial-of-service effects.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the general-user password policy.
2. Edit lockout settings.
3. Set automatic unlock to a finite duration that matches your support model.
4. Enable self-service account unlock if users may need to regain access without helpdesk intervention.
5. Save and verify lockout and unlock behavior.

Recommendation.Text: Set a finite automatic unlock duration or a documented recovery flow so lockout handling is predictable.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
